# Field boundaries for South Tyrol, Italy

Italy, South Tyrol field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Autonome Provinz Bozen - Südtirol. License: CC0-1.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/it_bz/latest/it_bz.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/it_bz/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25832; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: crop:code, metrics:area, geometry, id, crop:name, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/it_bz/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/it_bz/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/it_bz/collection.json
